decision: Never write shared session keys from the checkout flow — namespace all three to CHECKOUT_*.
why: "userToken", "userId" and "role" are all read by the staff dashboard on the same origin. Writing them here signs a staff user out mid-session, and the failure surfaces as {"message":"API TIMEOUT"} with HTTP 200 — which looks like a network problem and is not one. Cost an entire evening of re-derivation on 2026-07-30 because this note existed but was not in front of anyone.
